mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4% over three months signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when the trigger is met, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1 million units for two consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < 1000 for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for three consecutive months, accompanied by a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for two consecutive months, signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.0% for 3 months AND PAYEMS declines for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 70% of triggered periods, or the median return is not below the 5th percentile of the historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% for four consecutive months signals a broad-based contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -1.0% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically distinguishable from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid reduction in the federal funds rate below 1% during a recessionary environment signals an aggressive easing cycle that boosts risk asset valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered episodes, or the median return is below the long-run average annualized return.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% for six consecutive months signals robust demand expansion, which supports corporate earnings and justifies higher equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly change > 0.5% for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 70% of triggered periods, or the average return is below the 50th percentile of the historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 4% and a fall in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for two consecutive months signals labor market stress that depresses consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% AND PAYEMS declines for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the median return is not below zero.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.8% for five consecutive months signals a broad-based supply-side recovery, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change > 0.8% for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return is below the 25th percentile of the historical distribution.
